scientific_integrity: The known valuation on exponents 4 times powers of 7 is credited to Bayarmagnai and Delger; finite computations are distinguished from proof.
scientific_limitations: The prime 7 and the sum with bases 1, 2, 3 only; common periods need not be minimal. The result is independently unvalidated, and an unindexed equivalent result remains possible.
title: Exact seven-adic orders and persistent residue classes for a three-power sum
